fact: The Gambia Revenue Authority states that the rollout of ASYCUDA World has automated and streamlined clearance procedures.
The Gambia Revenue Authority states that strides in implementing the National Single Window have improved inter-agency coordination and reduced the time and cost of doing business.
The Gambia Revenue Authority reports its Commissioner of Customs is in discussions with UNCTAD on upgrading the existing ASYCUDA system to the new-generation cloud-based version.
The president of the clearing and forwarding agents association says the Gambia National Single Window has helped improve vessel turnaround and clearance time.
The Gambia Revenue Authority and Senegalese Customs agreed to install the GAINDE customs system at Karang, Keur Ayib and Selety border posts within three months.
ECOWAS says SIGMAT, its regional goods-in-transit data exchange system, was deployed to the Gambia's customs system in October 2024.
The Gambia Revenue Authority's Commissioner General said on 30 May 2025 that ASYCUDA moved from version 2.7 to ASYCUDA++ and then to ASYCUDA World in 2022.
The Gambia Revenue Authority lists a National Single Window for trade documentation among the digital initiatives it has implemented.

The UN Global Survey on Digital and Sustainable Trade Facilitation 2025 rates Gambia's Automated Customs System, and e-submission of sea and air cargo manifests, as fully implemented, with e-submission of customs declarations partially implemented.

The Gambia Revenue Authority Commissioner General says the Asycuda World system was launched in 2022, and the Finance Permanent Secretary says the upgrade from Asycuda ++ produced a major jump in international revenue mobilisation.
UNCTAD says The Gambia rolled out ASYCUDAWorld in 2022 and that around 80% of customs payments were made electronically that year, with customs revenue up 23% in 2023.
